title: Returning on Schedule and the Ridgeline Tool Rental Refuelling Charge
content:
Bringing Ridgeline Tool Rental equipment back on or ahead of schedule lowers the refuelling charge.

**Rule.** Returning on schedule lowers the refuelling charge: equipment returned on a calendar day before the due-back date has it multiplied by 0.90; equipment returned on the due-back date, by 0.95; equipment returned after the due-back date keeps it unchanged.

The return date and the due-back date are the date parts of the return time and the due-back time on the agreement; the hour of the return does not count.

The multiplier acts on the priced refuelling, service fee included, and the rounding to the cent is made only on the final figure.

## Input, judgement, result (due-back Friday 12 June at 17:00, priced refuelling of 24.00)

| Returned | Judgement | Figure |
|---|---|---|
| Thursday 11 June 16:00 | a calendar day before the due-back date, multiplier 0.90 | 21.60 |
| Friday 12 June 21:00 | on the due-back date, multiplier 0.95 | 22.80 |
| Saturday 13 June 08:00 | after the due-back date, unchanged | 24.00 |

The dates and the amount are hypothetical inputs.
